note: Not artifact-qualified (no buildArtifact()/execution_hash in the page). simulate() runs a Monte Carlo internally but with a hardcoded fixed seed (20260717, not exposed as a parameter) so it is fully deterministic call-to-call -- this fixture asserts REPRODUCIBILITY of that fixed-seed output, not independent correctness of the diffusion coefficient (the lam/rinfl/vorb/period terms ARE closed-form and independently checkable; tMed/pen come from the internal MC and are seed-frozen only). Value-only fixture, out of schema-validate.mjs's hash-bound coverage gate (OCS-FIXWAVE.md FW-1).

cases.name: ocs_defaults_a1000au
cases.source: Seed-frozen output of simulate(mbhMsun,aAU,sigmaKms,nstarPc3,eCross) at OCS clusterParams sigma=18.2, a=1000 AU. lamYr/vorbKms/rinflAU/periodDays are closed-form (encounter rate, vis-viva orbital speed, GM/sigma^2 influence radius, Kepler period) and independently verifiable from the formula in source; tDiffYr/pen are seed-frozen (internal fixed-seed 40000-draw MC over encounter diffusion), asserting reproducibility not independent correctness.

cases.name: haberle_lower_bound_a500au
cases.source: Same seed-frozen methodology at the Häberle et al. 2024 lower-bound mass (8200 Msun), a=500 AU.
